provider_test: Mocked successful generation, caching, corruption, budget rejection, timeout/pending reconciliation and generation-time licensing. End-to-end test reused original user-authorized takes; no voice takes are bundled with the skill.

render.subjectiveListening: Not independently auditioned by the assistant; review the delivered video for voice preference and pronunciation.

seek.pixelTolerance: max 3/255 and mean below 0.001/255; Chromium subpixel rounding

browser.method: Browser playback and Web Audio signal analysis; output sink silenced, not a subjective listening review.

visual_review: Contact sheet inspected: alternating paper/ink scenes, product/version lockup, task entry, five steps, three receipt reveals and closing lockup; no visible clipping in this fixture.
limits: One 15-second 16:9 preset. New release copy still requires source/visual review; signal checks do not establish pronunciation or subjective audio quality. Scheduling/publication adapters are not implemented.
